← All features

Calendar and field teams

Preventive plans, scheduled jobs and open work orders on one calendar, in day, week, month or list view, with a workload view per technician.

Unplanned jobs sit next to the calendar

Work orders with no date wait in their own tray. Drag one onto a day to schedule it, and the technician's workload updates with it.

Load per technician

The team view shows how many jobs each person is carrying. Somebody holding four jobs while a colleague holds none is visible before the shift, not after.

Filter to what you are planning

By technician, job type or machine, so a conversation about one line does not require reading the whole month.

Four views, one source

Preventive plans, scheduled jobs and open work orders are the same records, looked at from four angles.

  1. 01

    Day

    What is due today, by technician. This is the morning view, the one used to hand work out.

  2. 02

    Week

    The load across the next seven days. It shows collisions before they happen — two heavy preventive jobs on the same Thursday.

  3. 03

    Month

    The planning view. Preventive plans appear on the date they will write their work order.

  4. 04

    List

    The same thing without a calendar, filterable and sortable. This is the view you export or print.

  5. 05

    Workload per technician

    One lane per person, plus a tray of unplanned jobs. It answers “who can take this”.
